newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures end mixed in moderate trade.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures end mixed in moderate trade.

text.p: Sep 3 - IMM currency futures finished the session mixed and midrange, with trading moderate. Traders said some players began shifting positions as key employment report nears on Friday. Sept sterling ends up, buoyed by oil strength after U.S. missile raid on Iraq overnight, while Sept yen, Swiss franc, marks all lower. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
